Guys, seriously. I'm a new player but my team is already lvl 60 with DPS at e3 with lvl 5 talents and mostly maxed out skills. I can't even get through the first battle of the second difficulty of the first wave because each enemy has ~8k hp and inflicts vulnerability + hits like a truck.

I'm using mostly standard units because that's all I have atm. If the base standard units can't even do the second difficulty, something is wrong with the difficulty curve and stat scaling here.

I've been lurking around this discord and it seems like the endgame has been having some balancing issues thus far. I need the gnosis pieces to lvl up to 80, but I can't clear the stages to get the gnosis pieces without the stat boosts conferred by that. 

Please consider buffing the standard units, and just older units in general if you're planning to keep inflating stats like this. It's really unsustainable and as a survivor of Star Rail powercreep I feel like I might just drop this altogether if nothing changes.

Love the game and the story+atmosphere and lore, but the endgame is painfully unbalanced.
